system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Each state in the ASM other than the ‘ done’ state is associated with a unique prompt template. Prompt templates are filled with information from the local KG subgraph and the KG interface before presenting them to the LLM.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-state templates recomposed each step with KG content; paper only.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: At the start, a local KG subgraph is initialized to contain the entities present in the original query. It is then expanded using a tree search algorithm
env_context_strategy.note: Local KG subgraph injected into every prompt plus model-driven ExpandKG navigation; KG rather than repository environment.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no code/config available to check history processing. YAML subgraph is token-efficient but not compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Local KG subgraph is represented using a a to- ken efficient YAML format that minimizes repeti- tion for multiple edges on the same entity.
observation_format.note: YAML text rendered into prompt; closest is raw_text.

tool_call_format.note: Paper shows 'Selection:' completion prompts but no parser; code not in evidence.

tool_count.evidence_quote: We use a finite state ma- chine with the following actions: Think, Answer, ExpandKG, Select_Entities, and Select_Relation
tool_count.note: ASM actions, not function schemas; available per state varies.

edit_primitive.note: KG QA system, no file-editing; no tool registry in evidence to confirm absence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Prompt templates for all the states are in the Appendix F.1-F.3.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: (3) A tree search algorithm which defines the overall LLM search trajectory such as best first search, backtrack upon making a mistake, and termination condition when an answer is found.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: From the default state, Tree-of-Traversals can either Think, Answer, or choose to ExpandKG.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The algorithm equips a LLM with actions for interfacing a KG and enables the LLM to perform tree search over possible thoughts and actions

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The Tree-of-Traversals algorithm maintains a local KG subgraph that is repeatedly expanded until it contains all the information required by an LLM to answer the given query.
short_term_state.note: Tree nodes with ASM state, value, local KG subgraph.

self_verification.evidence_quote: This value is created by the LLM using eval- uation prompts (step evaluate in Algorithm 1).
self_verification.note: Same LLM values nodes and answers; could be read as llm_judge.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The search stops when an answer is found with a node value exceed- ing the threshold τ.
retry_policy.note: Search continues over branches until answer value > 0.8, capped at 20 expansions.

rollback.evidence_quote: Since the previous selection yielded low-value states, the model backtracks to the best alternative state.
rollback.note: Backtracking to stored tree states; closest value.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: max depth of the tree search, after which the algorithm is forced to transition to the done state (i.e., answer the query), and max expansions after which the model halts exploration and returns "Cannot find answer".
termination_condition.note: Answer action ends; value threshold τ stop coded test_pass (closest).

network_policy.note: Uses remote Wikidata SPARQL and MusicBrainz API, but no network policy surface in evidence.

eval_hooks.note: Paper evaluates on 2WikiMultiHop/QALD-10 but repo not in evidence.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Our results show that Tree-of- Traversals significantly improves performance on question answering and KG question answering tasks.
target_domain.note: KG question answering; closest value research (alternative: other).

open_source.note: Code released per paper but no LICENSE in evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: A novel zero-shot algo- rithm for augmenting any powerful LLM with arbitrary number of KGs

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Code is available at https: //github.com/amazon-science/ tree-of-traversals
primary_artifact.note: Only paper in evidence; repo not inspected.

first_release_date.note: Fallback to paper v1 date; tags/commits not available.
